items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: And Matty Matlock was in the band.

ctx.x: This was what, a five or six piece group?

Yeah. Like a Dixieland band, three horns and three rhythm. And Matty Matlock was in the band. He had record dates and stuff. And he used to send, like if they had a good sub that stood by — I probably could have done it. But anyhow it didn’t come up. The job finished. It seems like everything kind of coordinated just right. It finished and then I started to get record date calls. Funny, that was the days of, I guess I don’t know if they even called it rock & roll or rhythm & blues, with the triplets in the right…
Can you recall some of the records you played on?
